title: Practice 1: Every day, all week, on Saturdays

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Эта нефтяная скважина даёт более ста баррелей в ___ (день).
exercises.prompt: This oil well produces more than 100 barrels per day.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: This stream runs dry every summer.
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.ru: Был, да и теперь еще придется по ___.
exercises.why: «по» + dative. From Пётр Боборыкин, «Китай-город».

exercises.q: You have to pay 10,000 yen extra on holidays.
exercises.ru: В ___ нужно доплачивать десять тысяч иен.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Miss Klein gives a test every Friday.
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Занимаюсь этак между делом, по ___ (праздники), или когда не спится.
exercises.why: «по» + dative. From Антон Чехов, «Бабье царство».
«в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Many Welsh books are published every year.
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: По ___ (вёсны) пчелы гудьмя гудели на лозине.
exercises.why: «по» + dative. From Лев Толстой, «Вторая русская книга для чтения».

exercises.q: This custom is dying out nowadays.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Gordon has had his head in the clouds all week.
exercises.why: «весь» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«по» + dative. From Фёдор Достоевский, «Идиот».
«в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«весь» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.ru: Погодите еще, гусей по ___ считают! — процедил Майзель.
exercises.why: «по» + dative. From Дмитрий Мамин-Сибиряк, «Горное гнездо».

exercises.q: I always crammed for my tests overnight when I was a student.
exercises.ru: Студентом я всегда зубрил в ___ перед экзаменом.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The factory has been lying idle for a year.
exercises.why: «целый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«по» + dative. From Фёдор Достоевский, «Бобок».

exercises.prompt: My brother-in-law passed away last Wednesday.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: There's a sucker born every minute.
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
